quotes.text: What was your gross pay, that is your pay before any deductions, the last time you were paid?
Were you receiving any of these state benefits in your own right;, that is, where you were the named recipient?...
Which of you/them has the highest income (from earnings, benefits, pensions and any other sources)?
How many hours per week do you usually work in your (main) job/business – please exclude meal breaks?
In which of these ways do you occupy this accommodation? Make sure answer applies to HRP
Record if [Name] is person in whose name this accommodation is owned or rented

On a scale of 1 to 5, with 1 being 'very poor' and 5 being 'very good', how poor or good would you say managers at your workplace are at involving employees and their representatives in decision making?

assessments.reasoning: Regarding economic_maintenance: While the instrument collects employee earnings (GROSS99) and state benefits received in one's own right (TPBN13), and uses HIHNUM to identify the highest income earner for HRP selection, it does not collect member-level income across all sources (e.g. self-employment income, informal work, or remittances). Regarding labor_burden: The instrument captures hours worked in paid employment and unpaid business work (TOTUS1), but does not collect data on hours spent on unpaid domestic or care work. Regarding property_asset_control: Dwelling tenure (TEN1) is recorded at the household level specifically applying to the Household Reference Person, and HRPID only records whether accommodation is owned/rented in a member's name; it does not capture asset/property ownership by member. Regarding decision_making: The questionnaire includes workplace decision-making involvement (JOBREP) but contains no questions on intra-household decision-making by sphere.
